reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Containing the HIV epidemic and reduction of HIV-related morbidity and mortality in Belarus - Belarus (01-Jan-2016-31-Dec-2018)

description.narrative: Belarus, HIV, Republican Scientific and Practical Center for Medical Technologies, Informatization, Administration and Management of Health (RSPC MT)This program has the following goals: The containing the HIV epidemics and reduction of HIV-related morbidity and mortality in Belarus. The objectives of this program are: To build national capacities to fully uptake the programmatic and financial responsibility of HIV response in Belarus. To scale up the delivery of evidence-based, integrated and regionally prioritized package of HIV prevention and treatment services to key populations groups at risk of or affected by HIV. To strengthen community systems to ensure relevant, human rights and public health based, sustainable and integrated HIV response measures for key affected populations
